name: The Ravaged Caravan
summary: Morin Cloudstalker directs travelers to examine the wreckage of an ambushed Venture Company caravan near the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. Although the tauren torched the convoy in retribution for lost comrades, goblin salvagers returned to recover intact cargo. Investigating the surviving supply crates reveals the true industrial scale of the Venture Company's operations in Mulgore.

sections.title: Retribution by the Lake
sections.body: The charred remnants along the northern bank of Stonebull Lake are the result of a swift strike by the tauren. Grieving the loss of two companions killed in an earlier skirmish, Morin Cloudstalker and his warriors ambushed an armed Venture Company supply convoy. Intending to obliterate the intruders' efforts, the tauren torched the wagons and abandoned the smoking ruin, presuming fire would consume whatever the goblins sought to haul.

sections.title: Unfinished Business
sections.body: The tauren soon noticed Venture Company salvagers scouring the blackened debris, suggesting their fire had failed to destroy the most crucial cargo. Rather than risk further lives blindly, Morin dispatches scouts to inspect the wreckage. Among the soot-stained wreckage rest intact crates marked with the insignia of the Venture Company Mining Division, packed and destined for central processing facilities.

faq.answer: Morin Cloudstalker and his tauren warriors ambushed and torched the caravan in retaliation after losing two of their scouts in a previous clash with the Venture Company.

faq.q: Where is the Ravaged Caravan located?
faq.answer: The burnt wagons sit along the northern shore of Stonebull Lake, east of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

faq.q: Why are the goblins returning to the wreckage?
faq.answer: The Venture Company sent salvagers because fire failed to destroy all their cargo. They are attempting to retrieve durable supply crates stamped for shipment to their central processing operations.

faq.q: What is inside the supply crates?
faq.answer: The crates bear the insignia of the Venture Company Mining Division and contain mineral resources labeled for refinement and processing at their primary industrial plants.
Morin Cloudstalker is a tauren scout and tracker stationed east of Bloodhoof Village, tasked with monitoring hostile incursions across central Mulgore, particularly from the Venture Company.

faq.q: What does this caravan reveal about the Venture Company?
faq.answer: It shows that the Venture Company's presence in Mulgore is not a mere exploratory team, but an organized industrial extraction effort complete with armed supply lines and centralized refining networks.

angles.text: The desecration of the plains by Venture Company machines and timber-clearing strikes directly at your ancestral homeland, making the recovery and destruction of their supplies vital to the defense of Mulgore.
Unchecked corporate expansion into Mulgore threatens the stability of Thunder Bluff, requiring Horde scouts to disrupt Venture Company logistics.
The sturdy crates and logistics notes demonstrate the Venture Company's aggressive mineral surveying and extraction operations underway across Mulgore.
